Setup instructions

Follow the practical guide

Original installation instructions

  1. Codex CLI route: Review cesartevisual/threejs-skills. In the project run npx skills add cesartevisual/threejs-skills --agent codex --skill threejs-web.
  2. Invoke $threejs-web. Expect a responsive canvas plan, loading/error states and semantic controls.
Check before keeping it

Ask for one small result, inspect the output and permissions, and confirm it suits your app. If it fails, undo your changes and return to your original project.
